keyed.zh: 从海上一路打上去：先抢滩前哨岛 A，再登陆主岛拿下港口 C 和机场 D，最后攻下指挥部 E。上了主岛以后可以直接在目标前面的攻击出发阵地出生。每阵亡一人兵力少 1，兵力打光就输。
keyed.en: Fight your way in from the sea: storm Outpost A, land on the main island to take Port C and Airfield D, then seize Command E. Once ashore, spawn at the assault position in front of each objective. Every death costs one reinforcement; run out and you lose.

keyed.en: An enemy reinforced platoon holds the border post, no armour. Cross the berm and the anti-tank ditch and take objective A.

keyed.en: Two enemy platoons hold the border post and the oilfield with MG nests. Take both objectives.

keyed.zh: 敌机械化连守镇子一线，布雷德利、斯特赖克、JLTV 巡逻。任务：夜色掩护下连续拿下三个据点；带上反坦克武器。
keyed.en: A mechanised company holds the line up to the town with Bradleys, Strykers and JLTVs. Take three objectives under cover of night; bring anti-tank weapons.

keyed.zh: 两军在沙海遭遇，双方都有少量坦克和步战车。任务：突破边境沙墙、拿下油田，两个据点。
keyed.en: Meeting engagement in the Sand Sea, a few tanks and IFVs on both sides. Break the border berm and take the oilfield: two objectives.

keyed.zh: 敌防御纵深有 M1A1 坦克和布雷德利步战车。任务：连续拿下四个据点，撕开防线。
keyed.en: M1A1 tanks and Bradleys defend in depth. Take four objectives in a row and tear the line open.

keyed.zh: 坦克对决：敌 M1A1、M1A2 坦克连，我方 T-90M、99A。任务：在沙海连续拿下三个据点。
keyed.en: Tank duel: an M1A1/M1A2 company against our T-90Ms and Type 99As. Take three objectives in a row across the Sand Sea.

keyed.zh: 敌主力退守岩岭一线，五个据点层层设防。任务：打通沙海全部五个阶段。
keyed.en: The enemy main body falls back to the ridge, five objectives in layered defence. Break through all five stages.

keyed.zh: 敌重兵集团：M1A2、M1A1、布雷德利；我方 T-90M、99A、BMP-3 协同。任务：打通沙海全部五个阶段。
keyed.en: Heavy enemy group of M1A2s, M1A1s and Bradleys; our T-90Ms, Type 99As and BMP-3s attack together. Break through all five stages of the Sand Sea.

keyed.zh: 沙海前沿：敌摩步连有布雷德利、斯特赖克和少量 M1A1。任务：BMP-3 机步营突破两道沙墙阵地。

keyed.zh: 敌方是精锐步兵，没有车辆支援；地形开阔、狙击手多。任务：拿下沙海前三个据点。
keyed.en: Elite enemy infantry with no vehicles; open ground and many snipers. Take the first three objectives of the Sand Sea.

keyed.zh: 敌在边境构筑防线：M1A2、布雷德利、M1150 扫雷车。任务：T-90M、BMP-3 掩护步兵拿下三个据点。
keyed.en: A border defence line with M1A2s, Bradleys and M1150 breachers. T-90Ms and BMP-3s cover the infantry onto three objectives.

keyed.zh: 突破以后向纵深发展，敌坦克、步战车混编反冲击。任务：连续拿下四个阶段的据点。
keyed.en: Exploit the breach: enemy tanks and IFVs counter-attack together. Take the objectives of four stages in a row.

keyed.zh: 夜里沙海坦克战：敌 5 辆 M1A2、M1A1，我方 4 辆 T-90M、99A、96 式。用热像，先敌开火。任务：拿下四个阶段的据点。
keyed.en: Night tank battle in the Sand Sea: five M1A2/M1A1s against our four T-90Ms, Type 99As and Type 96s. Use thermals and shoot first. Take the objectives of four stages.

keyed.zh: 全线总攻：敌 30 人、4 辆装甲车顽抗。任务：拿下全部五个据点。
keyed.en: All-out assault: 30 enemies and 4 armoured vehicles hold out. Take all five objectives.

keyed.zh: 敌最后的装甲预备队：M1A2、M1A1、布雷德利。任务：打通沙海全部五个阶段。
keyed.en: The enemy's last armoured reserve of M1A2s, M1A1s and Bradleys. Break through all five stages of the Sand Sea.

keyed.zh: 敌全部兵力 36 人、5 辆装甲车最后一搏。任务：打通沙海全部五个阶段，拿下岭上指挥部。
keyed.en: Everything the enemy has left: 36 troops and 5 armoured vehicles. Break through all five stages of the Sand Sea and take the ridge command post.

keyed.en: In Studio a server builds only one map: stop, press Play again and pick {1} in the hangar's match box first

keyed.zh: 开新服务器没成功，留在这一局
keyed.en: Couldn't open a new server — staying here

keyed.zh: 按「{1}」开图，建好自动开始匹配
keyed.en: Building {1} — matchmaking starts when it's ready

keyed.zh: 车长望远镜 · 滚轮 缩放 · R 估距 · G 侦察 · C 收起 · Shift / 右键 进炮长瞄准镜
keyed.en: Binoculars · Wheel zoom · R range · G spot · C close · Shift / RMB gunner sight

keyed.zh: 靠上码头：导弹补满了，正在修理

keyed.en: Refueled, rearmed and resupplied with flares

keyed.zh: 核打击还要等 {1} 秒（每队发射后要冷却）
开战 {1} 秒后才能发射核导弹

keyed.zh: 惊雷-1 · 预计 {1} 秒后命中 · 我方不受伤害
keyed.en: HN-1 · impact in about {1}s · friendly units are safe

keyed.en: Enemy hypersonic nuke · impact in about {1}s · get out of the red circle

己方机场 · 停稳就加油补弹、维修
keyed.en: Friendly field · stop to refuel, rearm and repair

keyed.zh: 补给中 {1}% · 加油、挂弹、维修
补给、维修完毕 · 可以起飞
keyed.en: Resupplied and repaired · ready for takeoff

keyed.zh: 这里不能补给 · 回己方机场 / 甲板
keyed.en: No resupply here · return to a friendly field or deck

keyed.zh: 鼠标 飞行方向（战雷式鼠标瞄准：飞机自己追过去）· W/S 俯仰 · A/D 滚转 · Q/E 方向舵（按着就直接操纵，松开回到鼠标）· 按住右键（或 C）拖动自由看 · M 切纯键盘驾驶 · Shift 加油门 · Ctrl 收油门 · 滚轮 油门（地上收到底按住倒退）· B 减速板 · 左键 机炮（顺着机头打，敌机前面的小圈是提前量）· F 导弹 / 炸弹（雷达弹：R 选雷达屏上的目标、Alt+F 锁定，对方侧着飞会丢锁） · 1-6 选弹 · R 换目标 · Alt+R 雷达开关 · Alt+Q 雷达量程 · Alt+E 雷达模式（RWS / TWS / ACM）· Alt+Z 扫描方式 · ←/→ 雷达左右偏转 · Alt+↑↓ / Alt+滚轮 雷达天线俯仰 · Alt+C 天线回中 · Alt+T 选雷达目标 · Alt+F 雷达锁定 / 解锁 · F7 轰炸瞄准镜 · Shift+B 单投 / 双投 / 齐投 · Alt+中键 标目标点（落点到了自动投）· P 光电吊舱 · N 夜视 / 热成像 · X 热诱弹 · J 抛副油箱 · G 起落架 · 空格 跳伞
keyed.en: Mouse sets the flight direction (War Thunder mouse aim: the plane follows) · W/S pitch · A/D roll · Q/E rudder (held = direct control, release to follow the mouse) · hold RMB (or C) and drag to look around · M keyboard flight · Shift/Ctrl/mouse wheel throttle (hold Ctrl at idle on the ground to back up) · B airbrake · LMB gun (fires along the nose; the small circle ahead of enemy planes is the lead) · F missile / bomb (radar missiles: R picks a target on the radar screen, Alt+F locks it; beaming breaks the lock) · 1-6 select · R next target · Alt+R radar on/off · Alt+Q radar range · Alt+E radar mode (RWS / TWS / ACM) · Alt+Z scan pattern · ←/→ slew the radar left / right · Alt+↑↓ / Alt+wheel radar antenna elevation · Alt+C center antenna · Alt+T select radar target · Alt+F radar lock / unlock · F7 bombsight · Shift+B single / pair / salvo · Alt+MMB mark target point (auto release) · P targeting pod · N night vision / thermal · X flares · J drop tanks · G gear · Space bail out

keyed.zh: W 低头 · S 抬头 · A/D 滚转 · Q/E 方向舵 · Shift 加油门 · Ctrl 收油门（地上收到底按住倒退）· 滚轮 油门 · B 减速板 · 按住右键拖动自由看（看的方向不跟着飞机转，松开回到身后） · 左键 机炮（顺着机头打，敌机前面的小圈是提前量）· F 导弹 · 1-6 选弹 · R 换目标 · Alt+R 雷达开关 · Alt+Q 雷达量程 · Alt+E 雷达模式（RWS / TWS / ACM）· Alt+Z 扫描方式 · ←/→ 雷达左右偏转 · Alt+↑↓ / Alt+滚轮 雷达天线俯仰 · Alt+C 天线回中 · Alt+T 选雷达目标 · Alt+F 雷达锁定 / 解锁 · P 光电吊舱 · N 夜视 / 热成像 · X 热诱弹 · J 抛副油箱 · G 起落架 · M 切战雷式鼠标瞄准 · F7 轰炸瞄准镜 · Shift+B 单投 / 双投 / 齐投 · Alt+中键 标目标点（自动投弹）· 空格 跳伞
keyed.en: W nose down · S nose up · A/D roll · Q/E rudder · Shift throttle up · Ctrl throttle down (hold at idle on the ground to back up) · hold RMB and drag to look around (view stays put while the plane maneuvers) · LMB gun (fires at the nose marker; sticks to enemy vehicles within 6° and leads them) · F missile · 1-6 select · R next target · Alt+R radar on/off · Alt+Q radar range · Alt+E radar mode (RWS / TWS / ACM) · Alt+Z scan pattern · ←/→ slew the radar left / right · Alt+↑↓ / Alt+wheel radar antenna elevation · Alt+C center antenna · Alt+T select radar target · Alt+F radar lock / unlock · P targeting pod · N night vision / thermal · X flares · J drop tanks · G gear · M mouse aim (War Thunder) · F7 bombsight · Shift+B single / pair / salvo · Alt+MMB mark target point (auto release) · Space bail out

keyed.zh: 鼠标准心 定方向（同战雷）：往下 桨盘前倾往前飞，往上 往后仰（减速、往上顶）· W 升 / S 降（松开自动定高）· A/D 侧飞 · Q/E 转机头 · Alt 自由看 · 左键 机炮 · F 导弹 / 火箭 · 1-6 选弹 · R 换目标 · P 光电 · N 夜视 / 热成像 · X 热诱弹 · J 抛油箱 · 空格 下飞机
keyed.en: Aim sets the direction (like War Thunder): aim lower to tilt the rotor forward and fly ahead, aim higher to pitch back (slow down, rise) · W up / S down (holds altitude when released) · A/D sidestep · Q/E turn the nose · Alt free look · LMB gun · F missiles/rockets · 1-6 select · R next target · P pod · N night vision / thermal · X flares · J drop tanks · Space exit

keyed.zh: 弹已投出，吊舱一直对着目标。
keyed.en: Weapon away. Keep the pod on the target.

keyed.zh: 移动鼠标搜索目标，滚轮放大。
keyed.en: Slew to search. Wheel to zoom.

keyed.zh:
[P] 退出吊舱 · 鼠标 转动 · 滚轮 变焦
[Z] 宽 / 窄视场 · [V] 白热 / 黑热 / 电视
[R] 换目标 · 左键 投放 / 开火 · 飞机自动保持平飞
keyed.en:
[P] exit pod · mouse slew · wheel zoom
[Z] wide / narrow · [V] white-hot / black-hot / TV
[R] next target · click release / fire · autopilot holds level

keyed.zh: 重量 {1}（比一半内油、不挂副油箱）
选一型飞机，再改挂载和油量
keyed.en: Pick an aircraft, then set its loadout and fuel

keyed.zh: 重新部署（目标太远，不算阵亡）
按住 S 抬头离地（{1} km/h）
keyed.en: Hold S to lift off at {1} km/h

keyed.zh: 旋翼正在转起来，等转速到 100%
Tab 战况 · M 地图 · H 重新部署（不算阵亡）· N 夜视 · V 第一 / 第三人称 · F1 全部按键
keyed.en: Tab scoreboard · M map · H redeploy (no death) · N night vision · V 1st / 3rd person · F1 all keys

keyed.zh: 三步上手 · 回车关上
W / S 前进后退，A / D 转向（履带车能原地打转）
keyed.en: W / S to drive, A / D to steer (tracked vehicles can pivot in place)

keyed.zh: 鼠标转炮塔瞄准，左键开火，数字键选弹种 / 武器（看底下的弹药栏）
keyed.en: The mouse aims the turret, LMB fires, number keys pick the shell / weapon (see the ammo bar)

keyed.zh: Shift 进瞄准镜（V 切夜视 / 热成像），M 放烟幕，空格下车
keyed.en: Shift for the gunner sight (V: night / thermal), M smoke, Space to get out

keyed.zh: W / S 油门，A / D 转向：越快越灵，转弯会甩尾
keyed.en: W / S throttle, A / D steer: sharper at speed, the stern slides out

keyed.zh: 开到海滩、冲上沙滩，车会自动放下来
keyed.en: Run up onto a beach and the vehicle is set down automatically

keyed.zh: 接着开车从艇首开下去；空格下车
keyed.en: Then drive off over the bow; Space to get out

keyed.zh: Shift 推油门（推满进加力），A / D 在跑道上转向，油门收到底按住 Ctrl 倒退
keyed.en: Shift throttle up (full = afterburner); A / D steer on the runway; hold Ctrl at idle to back up

keyed.zh: 速度到 {1} km/h 按住 S 抬头离地，起落架会自动收起；W 低头、S 抬头、A / D 滚转，压坡度再拉 S 就转弯
keyed.en: At {1} km/h hold S to lift off — the gear retracts by itself. W nose down, S nose up, A / D roll; bank and pull S to turn

keyed.zh: 左键机炮（打机头标记那里），F 导弹（1–6 换挂载，先锁定），X 热诱弹；回去降落：G 放起落架、Ctrl 收油门、机头对着跑道，停稳就补弹修理
keyed.en: LMB gun (fires at the nose marker; sticks to enemy vehicles within 6° and leads them), F missile (1–6 stores, lock first), X flares. To land: G gear down, Ctrl throttle down, point the nose at the runway, stop to rearm and repair

keyed.zh: 先等旋翼转起来（平显上的转速到 100%）
keyed.en: Wait for the rotor to spin up (RPM 100% on the HUD)

keyed.zh: 按住 W 升、S 降（同战雷）；准心往下机头前倾往前飞，准心往上往后仰减速；A / D 侧飞、Q / E 转机头
keyed.en: Hold W to climb, S to descend (like War Thunder); aim lower to dip the nose and fly ahead, aim higher to pitch back and slow; A / D sidestep, Q / E turn

keyed.zh: 速度有惯性：不会马上停，准心往上一抬机头后仰刹车。左键机炮，F 火箭 / 导弹，空格下飞机
keyed.en: It keeps its momentum: aim higher to flare and brake. LMB gun, F rockets / missiles, Space to get out

keyed.zh: 你端着平板遥控无人机，人还站在原地——当心被打
keyed.en: You fly the drone from a tablet while standing where you are — stay covered

keyed.zh: 鼠标管方向，W / S 加速减速，A / D 滚转
keyed.en: The mouse steers, W / S speed, A / D roll

keyed.zh: 右键 / V 切镜头、Z 变焦，F 发导弹，空格收起平板
keyed.en: RMB / V camera, Z zoom, F missile, Space to put the tablet away

keyed.zh: W / S 调车钟，一档一档加减速；A / D 转舵——船大，转得慢
keyed.en: W / S set the engine order step by step; A / D rudder — big ships turn slowly

keyed.zh: 鼠标瞄准、左键开火：1 舰炮，2 反舰导弹（R 锁定）
keyed.en: Mouse aims, LMB fires: 1 guns, 2 anti-ship missiles (R to lock)

keyed.zh: 右键 / V 望远镜，N 夜视，空格下船
keyed.en: RMB / V binoculars, N night vision, Space to leave the ship
Mouse to aim, LMB to fire

keyed.zh: 右键 / V 瞄准镜，滚轮调倍率
keyed.en: RMB / V sight, wheel to zoom

keyed.zh: 鼠标指向要打的地方，旁边写着距离和射程
keyed.en: Point the mouse at the target; distance and range are shown

keyed.zh: 左键开炮，炮弹要飞几秒才落地
keyed.en: LMB fires — shells take a few seconds to land

keyed.zh: 右键放大看落点，空格离开
keyed.en: RMB to zoom in, Space to leave

keyed.zh: 坦克 · 装甲车 · 防空 · 火炮
选一种车，生成在这个车位上（名额按类别算）
keyed.en: Pick a vehicle to spawn on this bay (limits are per class)

keyed.zh: 你坐在后面 · 鼠标 看四周 · 空格 下飞机（在天上就跳伞）
keyed.en: You're a passenger · Mouse look · Space jump out (parachute if airborne)

keyed.zh: 不带发射器，跑得快一点
keyed.en: Travel light: move a little faster

keyed.zh: 全自动卡宾枪，近中距离都好用
keyed.en: Full-auto carbine for close to medium range

keyed.zh: 远距离一枪一个，爆头双倍
锁定直升机、飞机后发射
keyed.en: Lock on to helicopters and jets, then fire

keyed.zh: 点准星下的地面，炮弹几秒后落下
keyed.en: Aim at the ground; shells land a few seconds later

keyed.zh: 给身边的队友回血；救倒地的队友快一倍多、救起来满血
keyed.en: Heals teammates around you; revives downed teammates much faster and to full health
Detects and clears mines, cuts wire

keyed.zh: 标记敌人给全队看，呼叫炮火覆盖
keyed.en: Spots enemies for the team and calls in artillery

keyed.zh: 拿在手上就打开平板：空投步战车、空投补给、呼叫精确打击 / 机炮扫射 / 集束轰炸（R 币解锁）
keyed.en: Hold it to open the pad: airdrop an IFV or supplies, call precision strikes, gun runs and carpet bombing (unlocked with Robux)
Explodes a few seconds after the throw
Place it, use again to detonate

keyed.zh: 自动分队 · 机库挑车出击（回车）
keyed.en: AUTO TEAM · PICK A VEHICLE IN THE HANGAR (ENTER)

keyed.zh: 登陆联军 · 岛屿守备军
坦克 · 战机 · 直升机 · 舰艇
大家投票选这个服务器打哪张（能改票），票最多的开；后进来的直接加入
keyed.en: Everyone votes for this server's map (you can change your vote) — most votes wins; later players join it

keyed.zh: 两边基地各带一条跑道，中间一座城（约 2 公里见方）：老城街坊、高楼、公园、火车站、钢厂、电视塔 · 树撞得倒、炸得倒，楼炸多了会塌
keyed.en: Each side's main base has its own runway; a city sits in between (about 2 km across): old blocks, towers, a park, the rail station, a steel works and a TV tower · trees fall when rammed or shot, buildings collapse

keyed.zh: 海湾战争式的纯陆地沙漠（约 28 公里见方）：从南边的前进基地北上，五个阶段一个一个打 · 沙墙、油田、镇子、空军基地、岭上指挥部
keyed.en: A Gulf War desert with no sea (about 28 km across): push north from the forward base through five stages · border berm, oilfield, town, airbase, ridge command

keyed.zh: 投票中 · 还剩 {1} 秒 · {2} / {3} 人已投
投一票就开始倒计时：{1} 秒后按票数最多的开（平票随机）
keyed.en: The first vote starts a {1}s countdown — most votes wins (ties are random)

keyed.zh: 看屏幕上方的目标，再跟着菱形标记走。进入据点圈后，上方会显示占领进度。攻方要在圈内取得人数优势，才能推进占领。
keyed.en: Follow the objective at the top of the screen and its diamond marker. The capture meter appears inside the zone. Attackers must outnumber defenders in the zone to advance it.

keyed.zh: 地图上的载具生成点按 E 生成坦克、直升机、飞机和艇，走过去按 E 上车。
keyed.en: Press E at a vehicle pad to spawn tanks, helicopters, jets and boats; walk up and press E to get in.

keyed.zh: 阵亡以后在部署界面底下的装备格换枪械和装备。目标离得太远就按 H 重新部署（不算阵亡）。按 Tab 看战况。
keyed.en: After you die, change weapons and gear in the loadout slots at the bottom of the deploy screen. Objective too far away? Press H to redeploy (no death counted). Hold Tab for the scoreboard.

keyed.zh: 冲上前哨岛，拿下据点 A
keyed.en: Storm Outpost Island and take objective A

keyed.zh: 守住前哨岛 A，击退登陆部队。
keyed.en: Hold Outpost A against the landing.

keyed.zh: 夺取港口 C 和机场 D。拿下侧翼 B 可补充兵力。
keyed.en: Take C and D. Capture flank B for reinforcements.

keyed.zh: 守住港口 C 和机场 D
keyed.en: Hold Port C and Airfield D

keyed.zh: 登陆主岛，拿下港口 C
keyed.en: Land on the main island and take Port C

keyed.zh: 攻下指挥部 E，结束战斗
最后一道防线：死守指挥部 E
keyed.en: Last line: hold Command E at all costs

keyed.zh: 敌方占领进度正在回退
攻方兵力已经打光，不能再出生
新目标离你很远：按 H 重新部署（不算阵亡）
keyed.en: New objective is far away: press H to redeploy (no death counted)

keyed.zh: 天亮了：夜视仪收起（N 再开）
鼠标 飞行方向（准心）· W 加速 · S 减速 · A/D 滚转 · 左键 机炮 · F 导弹 · 1-6 选弹 · R 换目标 · 右键/V 切镜头 · Z 变焦（滚轮细调）· G 起落架 · 空格 收起平板
keyed.en: Mouse steer (aim) · W speed up · S slow down · A/D roll · LMB gun · F missile · 1-6 select · R next target · RMB/V switch view · Z zoom (wheel fine-tune) · G gear · Space stow tablet

keyed.zh: 无人机被击落，数据链中断
战术平板 · 呼叫支援
运输直升机吊运一辆车，挂伞投到目标点，落地就能开
keyed.en: A helicopter drops a vehicle under canopy — ready to drive on landing

keyed.zh: 补给箱：附近队友补满弹药、慢慢回血
keyed.en: Crate refills ammo and slowly heals nearby squadmates

keyed.zh: 点左边的区（或者车上的白圈）选在哪里贴爆反：炮塔正面、炮塔侧面、首上、侧裙板。火箭弹、导弹打在贴了爆反的地方，那一块炸开、伤害只剩两三成；没贴的地方直接挨。每少贴一个区车轻一点、快 1% 多。
keyed.en: Pick where to fit reactive armour (cards on the left or the circles on the tank): turret front, turret sides, upper glacis, side skirts. Rockets and missiles hitting a fitted area set off that brick and lose most of their damage; bare areas take the full hit. Each area left bare makes the tank a little lighter and faster.

keyed.zh: 激光告警 + 自动烟幕
T-90A 的「窗帘-1」：炮两边各一个 OTShU-1-7 红外干扰灯（就是那一对红色的大灯），加激光告警。被激光照上自动打烟；指令制导的反坦克弹（陶式、HOT、攻击……靠发射架盯着弹尾的红外灯修正）进到八百多米时约一半被干扰灯骗偏。
keyed.en: T-90A's Shtora-1: an OTShU-1-7 IR dazzler on each side of the gun (the pair of red lamps) plus laser warning. Laser illumination triggers auto smoke; command-guided ATGMs (TOW, HOT, Ataka…) are spoofed about half the time once within ~850 m.

keyed.zh: 「窗帘-1」干扰灯骗偏了来袭的反坦克导弹
keyed.en: Shtora-1 dazzlers spoofed the incoming ATGM

keyed.zh: 车尾、侧后、炮塔尾部栅栏
第二代爆反：对单装药破甲弹（火箭筒）很有效，打在块上伤害只剩三成；串联装药的导弹前级会先把它引爆，只挡一点；对穿甲弹没用。每格约 22 千克（估）。
keyed.en: 2nd-gen ERA: very effective against single-charge HEAT (RPGs) — a hit on a tile does 30% damage; tandem missiles defeat it with their precursor; useless against APFSDS. About 22 kg per tile (est.).

keyed.zh: 重型爆反（和接触-5 同一类：钢板厚、能把长杆穿甲弹打偏打断）：破甲弹剩两成多，串联导弹剩六成，穿甲弹削掉约两成（接触-5 官方说法：削掉约 20% 穿深）。每格约 45 千克（估）。
keyed.en: Heavy ERA (Kontakt-5 class: thick plates that deflect and break long rods): HEAT down to ~22%, tandem missiles ~60%, APFSDS loses ~20% (Kontakt-5 official claim: ~20% penetration). About 45 kg per tile (est.).

keyed.zh: 美军 TUSK 的 ARAT-1：M19 爆反块，每块 65 磅（约 29.5 千克，美国陆军 2020 年报道），对付火箭筒；串联装药导弹挡不住多少，对穿甲弹没用。
keyed.en: US TUSK ARAT-1: M19 reactive tiles, 65 lb each (about 29.5 kg, US Army 2020), aimed at RPGs; little effect on tandem missiles, none on APFSDS.

keyed.zh: TUSK II：在 M19 外面再叠一层 ARAT-2（M32，像屋顶的筒瓦），专门对付串联装药——导弹剩五成、火箭弹剩四分之一。原车自带的 M19 外面也会叠上。M32 的重量公开资料没有，按每格约 22 千克算（估）。
keyed.en: TUSK II: a second ARAT-2 layer (M32, curved like roof tiles) over the M19s, made for tandem warheads — missiles down to 50%, rockets to 25%. Also stacked over the factory M19s. M32 weight is not public; ~22 kg per tile assumed (est.).

keyed.zh: 北方工业 GL5：炮塔四角四个发射单元、四部毫米波雷达，方位 360°、高低只到 20°（陡着砸下来的攻顶弹拦不了），雷达 100 米外开始跟踪、离车约 10 米把来袭弹打爆。每个单元一发，游戏里 45 秒补一发。
keyed.en: NORINCO GL5: four launch units and four millimetre-wave radars at the turret corners; 360° azimuth but only 20° elevation (no top-attack defence); tracks from beyond 100 m and kills the threat about 10 m out. One round per unit; one refill every 45 s in game.

keyed.zh: 拉斐尔 Trophy（美军 M1A2 SEPv2、陆战队 M1A1 装过）：两侧各一个能转的发射器，EL/M-2133 雷达四块平板天线 360° 覆盖，同一个发射器两发至少隔 1.5 秒。加重约 5000 磅（2.3 吨），美军试验发现炮塔失衡、转得慢（这里炮塔转速 −10%）。每个发射器带几发没公开，按 4 发算。
keyed.en: Rafael Trophy (fitted to US Army M1A2 SEPv2 and USMC M1A1): two rotating launchers, four EL/M-2133 radar panels for 360° coverage, at least 1.5 s between shots from one launcher. Adds about 5,000 lb (2.3 t); US testing found turret imbalance and slower traverse (−10% here). Rounds per launcher are not public; 4 assumed.

keyed.zh: 激光告警接收机：激光制导的导弹 / 炸弹一照上你就报警、报方向，自动打一组烟幕弹——烟幕挡住激光照射点，导弹丢了目标。约 60 千克（估）。
keyed.en: Laser warning receivers: warn and give a bearing as soon as a laser-guided missile or bomb is aimed at you, and fire a smoke salvo automatically — the smoke hides the laser spot and the missile loses lock. About 60 kg (est.).

keyed.zh: 99A 的 JD-3：激光告警 + 激光压制（干扰对方的激光照射）+ 自动烟幕。公开资料很少，游戏里按：报警、自动打烟，并有约四成五的机会直接让来袭导弹丢失目标（估）。约 120 千克（估）。
keyed.en: The 99A's JD-3: laser warning + laser countermeasure (jamming the designator) + auto smoke. Little is public; in game it warns, fires smoke, and has about a 45% chance to break the missile's lock outright (est.). About 120 kg (est.).

keyed.zh: 车尾、侧面后段（发动机舱外）、炮塔尾部后面离车身约半米的一排扁钢条：火箭弹（单装药破甲）打在上面，约一半被卡坏引信、不炸（维基百科：大约挡下 50%）；对导弹、炮弹没用。约 650 千克（估）。
keyed.en: Flat steel bars about half a metre off the hull rear, rear sides (engine bay) and turret bustle: roughly half of single-charge rockets hitting them have their fuze crushed and fail to detonate (Wikipedia: about 50%); no effect on missiles or shells. About 650 kg (est.).

keyed.zh: 车底加一整块防雷板：压上反坦克雷、炸药在车底炸，这辆车挨的减半（估）。约 1.3 吨（估）。
keyed.en: A full belly plate: anti-tank mines or charges under the hull do half damage (est.). About 1.3 t (est.).

keyed.zh: Pearson 全宽扫雷犁：3600 千克，扫出 4.2 米宽、175–300 毫米深的通路，犁地时车速 1–15 公里 / 时，升起要 11 秒。开车时按 J 放下 / 升起：放下时车头前面这条通路里的雷被翻到两边、不炸。
keyed.en: Pearson full-width mine plough: 3,600 kg, clears a 4.2 m lane 175–300 mm deep at 1–15 km/h, 11 s to raise. Press J while driving to lower or raise it: mines in the lane ahead are turned aside without detonating.

keyed.zh: 多光谱伪装网（萨博梭鱼 MCS 这一类）：挡可见光、近红外、热红外和雷达，敌方机器人、车辆发现你的距离只剩七成（估）。只披在侧面、后面，不盖车顶、不挡观瞄。约 300 千克（估）。
keyed.en: Multispectral camouflage (Saab Barracuda MCS class): covers visual, near-IR, thermal and radar bands; enemy bots and vehicles spot you at 70% of the usual range (est.). Only on the sides and rear — not the roof, not over optics. About 300 kg (est.).

keyed.zh: 点车身上的格子贴 / 拆爆反：车顶不贴，观瞄、潜望镜、车灯、烟幕弹发射器、舱盖旁边的不贴，炮塔转动、炮管压低扫过的地方也不贴。原车自带的块拆不掉。
keyed.en: Click cells on the hull to fit or remove ERA: nothing on the roof, nothing over sights, periscopes, lights, smoke launchers or hatches, nothing where the turret or a depressed gun would sweep. Factory tiles cannot be removed.

keyed.zh: 进攻  ·  从南边打进河谷
从南边的主基地出发（车场、直升机坪、跑道都在基地里）：先拿下锯木厂 A，再打西坡上的雷达站 B、河边的山村 C、冰湖边的水电站 D，最后攻下北边的山口检查站 E。谷里到处是山梁和冲沟：车体藏在梁后面打，冰面上没有掩护。
keyed.en: Roll out of the southern main base (motor pool, helipads and runway are all inside): take the Sawmill A, then the Radar Station B on the west slope, the Village C by the river, the Hydro Plant D by the ice lake, and finally the Mountain Pass E in the north. The valley is full of ridges and gullies: fight hull-down behind the crests — there is no cover on the ice.

keyed.en: Hold the valley point by point: Sawmill A, Radar Station B, Village C, Hydro Plant D and the Pass E. Fight from the high ground (the radar plateau, the shoulders of the pass); the village ruins can hide a tank.

Rockets and missiles hitting a fitted area set off that brick and lose most of their damage; bare areas take the full hit. Each area left bare makes the tank a little lighter and faster.

T-90A's Shtora-1: an OTShU-1-7 IR dazzler on each side of the gun (the pair of red lamps) plus laser warning. Laser illumination triggers auto smoke; command-guided ATGMs (TOW, HOT, Ataka…) are spoofed about half the time once within ~850 m.
Shtora-1 dazzlers spoofed the incoming ATGM
2nd-gen ERA: very effective against single-charge HEAT (RPGs) — a hit on a tile does 30% damage; tandem missiles defeat it with their precursor; useless against APFSDS. About 22 kg per tile (est.).

Heavy ERA (Kontakt-5 class: thick plates that deflect and break long rods): HEAT down to ~22%, tandem missiles ~60%, APFSDS loses ~20% (Kontakt-5 official claim: ~20% penetration). About 45 kg per tile (est.).
US TUSK ARAT-1: M19 reactive tiles, 65 lb each (about 29.5 kg, US Army 2020), aimed at RPGs; little effect on tandem missiles, none on APFSDS.

TUSK II: a second ARAT-2 layer (M32, curved like roof tiles) over the M19s, made for tandem warheads — missiles down to 50%, rockets to 25%. Also stacked over the factory M19s. M32 weight is not public; ~22 kg per tile assumed (est.).

NORINCO GL5: four launch units and four millimetre-wave radars at the turret corners; 360° azimuth but only 20° elevation (no top-attack defence); tracks from beyond 100 m and kills the threat about 10 m out. One round per unit; one refill every 45 s in game.

Rafael Trophy (fitted to US Army M1A2 SEPv2 and USMC M1A1): two rotating launchers, four EL/M-2133 radar panels for 360° coverage, at least 1.5 s between shots from one launcher. Adds about 5,000 lb (2.3 t); US testing found turret imbalance and slower traverse (−10% here). Rounds per launcher are not public; 4 assumed.

Laser warning receivers: warn and give a bearing as soon as a laser-guided missile or bomb is aimed at you, and fire a smoke salvo automatically — the smoke hides the laser spot and the missile loses lock. About 60 kg (est.).

The 99A's JD-3: laser warning + laser countermeasure (jamming the designator) + auto smoke. Little is public; in game it warns, fires smoke, and has about a 45% chance to break the missile's lock outright (est.). About 120 kg (est.).

Flat steel bars about half a metre off the hull rear, rear sides (engine bay) and turret bustle: roughly half of single-charge rockets hitting them have their fuze crushed and fail to detonate (Wikipedia: about 50%); no effect on missiles or shells. About 650 kg (est.).
A full belly plate: anti-tank mines or charges under the hull do half damage (est.). About 1.3 t (est.).

Pearson full-width mine plough: 3,600 kg, clears a 4.2 m lane 175–300 mm deep at 1–15 km/h, 11 s to raise. Press J while driving to lower or raise it: mines in the lane ahead are turned aside without detonating.

Multispectral camouflage (Saab Barracuda MCS class): covers visual, near-IR, thermal and radar bands; enemy bots and vehicles spot you at 70% of the usual range (est.). Only on the sides and rear — not the roof, not over optics. About 300 kg (est.).

Click cells on the hull to fit or remove ERA: nothing on the roof, nothing over sights, periscopes, lights, smoke launchers or hatches, nothing where the turret or a depressed gun would sweep. Factory tiles cannot be removed.
